name: amazon_search_first_result_price
intent: Search for a product on Amazon and report the price of the first result
description: Opens Amazon search, runs the requested product search, and reports the price of the first result shown under Results.
patterns: search Amazon and tell me the price of the first result
look up a product on Amazon and report its first price
what is the first result price for this on Amazon

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: Product or product type to search for on Amazon

steps.intent: Tap the Search box to open Amazon search
Tap the {{search_query}} suggestion to run the search

outputs.name: first_result_product
outputs.example: Energizer MAX AA Batteries (20 Pack), Double A Alkaline Batteries

outputs.name: first_result_price
outputs.near: Energizer MAX AA Batteries (20 Pack), Double A Alkaline Batteries
